keys: Automatic follows the interface macOS sends traffic through. Throughput is measured while the widget is in the Nook, so the graph already has history when the Nook opens.
When on, the widget asks api.ipify.org for the address your traffic appears to come from: when the network changes and every 10 minutes while the Nook is open. Off by default.
macOS shows Wi‑Fi network names only to apps with Location Services access. Without it, the widget shows “Wi‑Fi” with the signal, channel and rate.
